(def isa?
  "Returns true if (= child parent), or child is directly or indirectly derived from
  parent through a relationship established via derive. h must be a hierarchy
  obtained from make-hierarchy, if not supplied defaults to the global
  hierarchy"
  (fn
    ([child parent] (isa? @(get-global-hierarchy) child parent))
    ([h child parent]
     (or (= child parent)
         (contains? ((:ancestors h) child) parent)
         (and (vector? parent) (vector? child)
              (= (count parent) (count child))
              (loop [ret true i 0]
                (if (or (not ret) (= i (count parent)))
                  ret
                  (recur (isa? h (child i) (parent i)) (inc i)))))))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). Suss types have no supertypes, so the type-inheritance branches of Clojure's and ClojureScript's versions (bases, supers, isAssignableFrom) contribute nothing and are removed (#30). Vectors compare element counts with =, as Clojure does.
